caption: Do Melchizedek’s titles predict Jesus? “King of righteousness” and “king of peace” describe Melchizedek himself. Hebrews makes the comparison much later.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Do these titles point to Jesus? The name Melchizedek can be read as “king of righteousness,” and Salem sounds like “peace.” Hebrews connects both ideas with Jesus.
slides.body: The name Melchizedek can be read as “king of righteousness,” and Salem sounds like “peace.” Hebrews connects both ideas with Jesus.
slides.heading: Do these titles point to Jesus?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Gen 14:18: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine—since he was priest of God Most High—
slides.body: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine—since he was priest of God Most High—
slides.heading: Gen 14:18

slides.alt_text: The claimed New Testament fulfilment in Heb 7:2–3, BSB: First, his name means ‘king of righteousness.’ Then also, ‘king of Salem’ means ‘king of peace.’ Like the Son of God, he remains a priest for all time.
slides.body: First, his name means ‘king of righteousness.’ Then also, ‘king of Salem’ means ‘king of peace.’ Like the Son of God, he remains a priest for all time.
slides.heading: Claimed fulfilment · Heb 7:2–3

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Why Christians connect them Hebrews compares Melchizedek with the Son of God. A king and priest associated with righteousness and peace makes a striking picture of Jesus.
slides.body: Hebrews compares Melchizedek with the Son of God. A king and priest associated with righteousness and peace makes a striking picture of Jesus.
slides.heading: Why Christians connect them

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: But they describe Melchizedek In Genesis, the name and title belong to Melchizedek himself. Nothing there says a future person will carry the same meaning. Hebrews makes the connection later.
slides.body: In Genesis, the name and title belong to Melchizedek himself. Nothing there says a future person will carry the same meaning. Hebrews makes the connection later.
slides.heading: But they describe Melchizedek

title: Did ‘king of righteousness and peace’ predict Jesus?
